title: Placement and airflow — corrected
caption: Corrected calibration: exactly three brand airflow lines and one restrained wrong-position outline.
source: Revision of placement-bedroom-calibration after visual QA
motif: bedroom, side-wall split system, exactly three airflow lines, one warning outline
palette: warm white, pale ice, light oak, MVN teal, minimal coral warning
annotation: The first version used four teal airflow lines. Regenerate with exactly three and preserve the approved visual language.
prompt: Create one self-contained 16:9 editorial HVAC illustration for the MVN Climate Atlas visual system. Clean restrained architectural 3D illustration with precise flat technical overlays, matte materials, warm-white and pale-ice interior, light oak and mist-gray details. Consistent three-quarter isometric camera, 38 mm lens, camera height 1.65 m, slight 10-degree downward angle, vertical lines straight. Soft daylight from upper left at 5200K, gentle short shadows, quiet premium engineering mood. Use one and only one physical fictional MVN Reference Split 01: matte warm-white indoor unit, visually about 880 by 295 by 210 mm, softly rounded corners, one graphite lower seam and one continuous louver, no logo and no readable display. Calm modern bedroom, unit installed high on the right-side wall near the headboard. The AirFlow system is a strict brand requirement: draw EXACTLY THREE teal airflow lines total, no fourth line, no extra trace, no duplicate. The three lines are smooth, parallel and evenly spaced, #11B8B2, 8-pixel visual weight at 1600 by 900 scale, rounded ends, flowing from the physical unit leftward along the open side of the room and safely away from the bed. Put one small directional chevron on each of the three lines near their far ends, exactly three chevrons total. A wrong placement on the opposite wall is shown only as one restrained thin coral ghost outline of a unit and one coral X; do not draw airflow lines from the ghost outline. Include one small deep-teal measurement point near pillow height. Bed in the lower-right, the open safe airflow zone across the left half, clean walls, one light-oak bedside table, neutral mist-gray textiles. Keep unit, bed, three airflow lines and ghost warning inside the central 80 percent safe area, 2400 by 1350 composition. No text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, second physical air conditioner, fourth airflow line, airflow from the warning outline, multiple crosses, extra arrows, extra icons, person, clutter, collage, split-screen frame, stock-photo look, watercolor, flat clipart, glossy advertising render, cyberpunk, dark room, hard shadow, fisheye, floating UI or deformed architecture. Single coherent frame, not a grid, contact sheet or mood board layout. Count the teal airflow lines before finalizing: the final image must contain exactly three.
